Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S21 Save & Extract and the task list on phone width and WebKit

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). … (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Visual-lane profiles pixel7 (Chromium) and iphone15 (WebKit)

When Open the Encounter tab with the 1,213-character S10 text in the box, then Post-Round → Tasks with a 120-character task

Then Save & Extract stays visible and tappable (not covered, at least 24 px); task texts wrap, nothing cut off or overflowing

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): visual-lane findings covered/overflow/truncated/tap = 0 on these screens (findings go to a human)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

In both contexts, with the 1,269-character S10 text in the encounter box, Save & Extract stays visible, uncovered, enabled and at least 24 px; on Post-Round → tasks the 120-character task wraps with nothing cut off or overflowing. No model involved.

Evidence: 10 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):
